/-- Karatsuba's split `B = min(a->used, b->used) >> 1` (a `def`: `omega` keeps it an atom). -/
def Bk (p : P) : Nat := min p.a.used p.b.used / 2
abbrev NX (p : P) : Nat := initPrec (Bk p)
abbrev NY (p : P) : Nat := initPrec (p.a.used - Bk p)
abbrev NW (p : P) : Nat := initPrec (p.b.used - Bk p)
abbrev NT (p : P) : Nat := initPrec (2 * Bk p)

def ρK (p : P) (IX IY IZ IW IT IU IV IC : Iv) : X → Iv :=
  Iv.upd (Iv.upd (Iv.upd (Iv.upd (Iv.upd (Iv.upd (Iv.upd (Iv.upd (ρX p) (nR .dX) IX) (nR .dY) IY) (nR .dZ) IZ) (nR .dW) IW) (nR .dT) IT) (nR .dU) IU) (nR .dV) IV) (nR .cD) IC

theorem sub3 {pp : P} (hF : 232 ≤ (layG pp .stk).len) (y : Y) : (ρ3 pp y).Sub (layG pp (proj y)) := by
  have hF' : 232 ≤ 2736 + 8 * (pp.a.used + pp.b.used) := by simp only [layG, MulAlg.lay] at hF; omega
  rcases y with _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | r
  all_goals first
    | (simp [ρ3, Split.lay, layG, MulAlg.lay, proj, Iv.Sub]; omega)
    | (cases r <;> simp [ρ3, Split.lay, layG, MulAlg.lay, Api.MpMul.lay, proj, Iv.Sub] <;> omega)

theorem offG {pp : P} {mm : Mem} {rr : BitVec 64} (hP : GPre pp mm rr) (r : R) : Off (layG pp r) (Api.MpMul.hin pp) := by
  cases r
  all_goals first
    | exact Off.nil _
    | exact hP.off .stk | exact hP.off .aS | exact hP.off .aD | exact hP.off .bS | exact hP.off .bD
    | exact hP.off .cS | exact hP.off .cD | exact hP.off .kc | exact hP.off .tc | exact hP.off .code

theorem posG {pp : P} {mm : Mem} {rr : BitVec 64} (hP : GPre pp mm rr) (y : Y) :
    0 < (ρ3 pp y).len ∨ (ρ3 pp y).base < heapStart ∨ heapEnd ≤ (ρ3 pp y).base := by
  have := hP.res.apos; have := hP.res.bpos; have := hP.res.cpos
  rcases y with _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | r
  all_goals first
    | (left; simp [ρ3, Split.lay, layG, MulAlg.lay] <;> omega)
    | (cases r
       all_goals first
         | (right; left; simp [ρ3, Split.lay, layG, Iv.nil]; decide)
         | (left; simp [ρ3, Split.lay, layG, MulAlg.lay, Api.MpMul.lay, textIv, textLen]; try omega))

/-- The heap checkpoint at the entry. -/
theorem entry_hp {pp : P} {mm : Mem} {rr : BitVec 64} (hP : GPre pp mm rr) :
    HP (ρX pp) wX (Api.MpMul.hin pp) (Api.MpMul.hin pp) (InAny (MulAlg.lay pp) Api.MpMul.ws) mm mm := by
  have hF : 232 ≤ (layG pp .stk).len := by simp only [layG, MulAlg.lay]; omega
  have hstk : Ram (layG pp .stk).base (layG pp .stk).len := (hP.bund .stk).2
  refine HP.entry hP.heap (fun y => (offG hP (proj y)).sub (sub3 hF y) (posG hP y)) ?_ ?_
  · intro y hy q hq
    have hs := sub3 hF y
    have hq2 : (ρ3 pp y).In q := hq
    have hq' : (layG pp (proj y)).In q := by unfold Iv.Sub Iv.In at *; omega
    rcases y with _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | r
    all_goals first
      | exact InAny.of_mem (w := Api.MpMul.R.stk) (by decide) hq'
      | (cases r <;> simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, isW] at hy
         all_goals first
           | exact InAny.of_mem (w := Api.MpMul.R.stk) (by decide) hq'
           | exact InAny.of_mem (w := Api.MpMul.R.cS) (by decide) hq'
           | exact InAny.of_mem (w := Api.MpMul.R.cD) (by decide) hq'
           | (simp [proj, layG, Iv.nil, Iv.In] at hq'; omega))
  · intro y hy
    have hs := sub3 hF y
    rcases y with _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | r
    all_goals first
      | exact Ram.sub hstk hs.1 hs.2
      | (cases r <;> simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, isW] at hy
         all_goals first
           | exact Ram.sub hstk hs.1 hs.2
           | simpa [ρ3, Split.lay, layG, MulAlg.lay, Api.MpMul.lay, Layout.sizeofMpInt] using (Hdr.geom (show Hdr mm pp.pc pp.cdp pp.c from (hP.bund .cS).2)).st
           | simpa [ρ3, Split.lay, layG, MulAlg.lay, Api.MpMul.lay] using (show Dig mm pp.cdp pp.c.alloc pp.c.digit from (hP.bund .cD).2).ram
           | simpa [ρ3, Split.lay, layG] using Ram.nil)
